title: Scalable Sparse Autoregressive Variational Inference for Non-Gaussian Spatial Fields
abstract: arXiv:2610.13656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent field models are essential for spatial statistics, but the posterior distribution of the latent field, even with a Gaussian process (GP) prior, is analytically intractable whenever the likelihood is non-Gaussian. Existing approximations are either too slow or too restrictive for large non-Gaussian datasets. We present a scalable variational inference framework that mirrors the sparse nearest-neighbor autoregressive structure of the prior in the variational family, uses normalizing-flow conditionals for expressiveness, and amortizes all variational parameters via a single shared neural conditioner. Doubly stochastic optimization with reduced ancestor sets achieves polylogarithmic complexity per iteration.

translated_title: 面向非高斯空间场的可扩展稀疏自回归变分推断
translated_abstract: 潜场模型是空间统计学中的重要工具，但即使采用高斯过程（GP）先验，只要似然函数是非高斯的，潜场的后验分布在解析上便是不可求解的。现有的近似方法对于大规模非高斯数据集而言，要么速度太慢，要么限制过多。我们提出了一种可扩展的变分推断框架，该框架在变分族中镜像了先验的稀疏最近邻自回归结构，使用归一化流条件分布以增强表达能力，并通过单个共享的神经条件器对所有变分参数进行摊销。结合缩减祖先集的双随机优化方法，实现了每次迭代的对数多项式复杂度。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的变分推断框架，通过在变分族中镜像稀疏最近邻自回归先验结构、使用归一化流条件分布和共享神经条件器摊销参数，并以双随机优化实现对数多项式迭代复杂度，从而高效解决大规模非高斯空间场的后验推断难题。
en_tdlr: A scalable variational inference framework that mirrors the sparse nearest-neighbor autoregressive prior structure, employs normalizing-flow conditionals with amortized variational parameters, and achieves polylogarithmic per-iteration complexity for posterior inference on large non-Gaussian spatial fields.
